notes.title: Important Update
notes.content:
We've just issued an important patch which fixes an issue preventing some scenes from working properly. 

For those who've purchased, please make sure the game updates before you launch it next time, and if you have problems, restarting Steam should do the trick.  New buyers will automatically have the patched version.

Hope you're all enjoying the game!

The State of Play team
